The '''Garena Premier League 2014 Spring''' was the Spring iteration of the 2014 [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL''') season, the premier regional League of Legends competition for Southeast Asia, held from February 12 to April 6, 2014. The tournament featured twelve teams competing for a total prize pool of $200,000 {{Abbr/USD}}, with matches played online during the Group Stage and concluding with offline Playoffs at Nhà thi đấu TDTT Phú Thọ in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. 

The competition began with a Group Stage where teams were split into two groups of six, playing a Double Round Robin format with all matches played as {{Abbr/Bo1}}. The top four teams from each group advanced to the Playoffs, which were contested in a Single Elimination bracket with all matches played as {{Abbr/Bo5}}. Results from the split awarded GPL points toward seasonal standings.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage:''' 
** Teams are divided into two (2) groups of six (6) teams 
** Double Round Robin, {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 4th place of each group''}} advances to the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''5th and 6th place''}} are eliminated.
* '''Playoffs:'''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
